uncertainties.meaning: Whether the centre collects enough units by Tuesday 4:00 PM to ship 150 units. The centre starts with 40 units, collects Monday 9-5 (8 hours at 12/hr = 96 units) and Tuesday 9-4 (7 hours at 12/hr = 84 units), total 40+96+84=220 units, which is enough. So this is actually certain.

Whether the centre collects enough units by Thursday 4:00 PM to ship 150 units. After Tuesday shipment, centre has 220-150=70 units. Wednesday collection 9-5 (8 hours at 12/hr = 96 units) gives 70+96=166 units. Thursday collection 9-4 (7 hours at 12/hr = 84 units) gives 166+84=250 units, enough. So certain.
Whether the Tuesday shipment arrives before Friday noon. Departs Tuesday 4:00 PM, takes 3 hours, arrives Tuesday 7:00 PM, well before Friday noon. Certain.
Whether the Thursday shipment arrives before Friday noon. Departs Thursday 4:00 PM, takes 3 hours, arrives Thursday 7:00 PM, before Friday noon. Certain.
The exact number of units the hospital holds at Friday noon. This is determined by initial 15 units plus two shipments of 150 each = 315 units. No uncertainty.
